acc: File-only host: use tools.mcp__node_repl__js through functions.exec. Its arguments are {code: string, title: string}. In code: var fs = await import("node:fs/promises"); nodeRepl.write(await fs.readFile("/absolute/named/file","utf8")); search a named file by filtering its lines or parsing JSON. Write with fs.writeFile. No subprocess, shell, web, connector, folder listing or outside-lane files. Each file read/search/write counts one call, even batched. tools.view_image through functions.exec, followed by image(result.image_url), opens named image files. Record exact counted total in your final receipt. Do not reread instructions. Format is in INSTRUCTIONS.md; separate RECEIPT_FORMAT.md mirrors it and need not be read.

Packet limits: line_sources.txt clips quotes at 600 characters; search facts.json for the full quote before declaring a line unsupported. Live L facts are inherited provenance, not independent medical confirmation. Read the superseding source-resolution section at the end of adjudication notes: the old open labels preserve history and do not describe final evidence. New source quotes must actually support the changed claims and their scope; the lead does not grant medical PASS.
